Back up sessions

This page copies the sessions stored on an FM-1 running Lilliput — each with its patch, its 16 snapshots, its gesture loops, its drums and its compressor — and the global setup to a file on this computer, and puts them back from that file. Use it before you install another firmware (another firmware may erase them): when you come back to Lilliput, restore the file here. It works in a desktop Chrome, Edge or Opera, over USB MIDI. Nothing is uploaded anywhere: the file stays on this computer.

Not connected

Connect the FM-1 with a USB data cable, switch it on, then find it.

On the FM-1
In the file
no file opened

Restore

Open a backup file, then write it to the FM-1. Every session in the file replaces the one in the same slot on the FM-1. The other sessions on the FM-1 are kept.

Notes

  • Close any other program using MIDI (a DAW, M-VAVE's app), and allow MIDI access when the browser asks: the sessions travel as MIDI system-exclusive messages.
  • Only an FM-1 whose USB name is FM-1 Lilliput is asked. Tonitor, Bigorna and Lilliput answer the same protocol, but their sessions are not Lilliput's, and Lilliput's are never written to them.
  • Each session is copied whole and checked before it is written: one that does not arrive intact is refused, and the session already in that slot is kept.
  • The FM-1 keeps playing while this page works; writing to its flash silences the audio for a moment each time. While a restore runs, saving or loading a session on the FM-1 shows BUSY: leave it alone until it is done.
  • The session playing on the FM-1 is not changed by a restore: load it again (SHIFT + SAVE, then SAVE) to hear what was restored. Save it first if it has changes you want to keep.

The page (js/backup.js) and the part of the firmware that answers it (firmware/src/backup.c) are GPL-3.0, on GitHub. They follow Tonitor's backup page.
